ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT 
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS IN ('5', '6', '7', 'A') THEN BCC.CRDACCT_CHGOFF_IND ELSE NULL END AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = 1

UNION

    SELECT 
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS as CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS IN ('5', '6', '7', 'A') THEN BCC.CRDACCT_CHGOFF_IND ELSE NULL END AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = 1


)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM  TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus WHERE RN = 1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS,FinancialInstitutionId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,
    CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    and SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    and SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':'))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId and  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusNote AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,SRC.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId 

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodStartTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PeriodEndTimestamp, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT') and CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL; 

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;


END
